title: Implement writing markdown to existing Google Doc tabs
description:
Implement a feature allowing users to write markdown content to a specific tab in an existing Google Document.

## Use Case
User provides a Google Doc URL (with tab ID in the URL) and a markdown file. The tool writes the markdown content to that specific tab, respecting document formatting.

## Example Usage
```bash
# URL contains tab ID: https://docs.google.com/document/d/DOC_ID/edit?tab=t.TAB_ID
gdrive-upload -f report.md --doc-url "https://docs.google.com/document/d/abc123/edit?tab=t.xyz789"

# Or specify tab separately
gdrive-upload -f report.md --doc-id abc123 --tab-id t.xyz789
```

## Technical Approach
- Parse tab ID from Google Doc URL (format: `?tab=t.TAB_ID`)
- Use Google Docs API `batchUpdate` with `tabId` parameter
- Convert markdown → structured content requests (InsertTextRequest, UpdateTextStyleRequest, etc.)

## Risks & Mitigations

### 1. Data Loss - Overwriting Existing Content
**Risk**: Writing to a tab could destroy existing content
**Mitigations**:
- Default to APPEND mode (add to end of tab)
- Require explicit `--replace` flag to clear tab first
- Show preview of existing content before write
- Prompt for confirmation unless `--force` specified

### 2. Permission Errors
**Risk**: User may not have edit access to document
**Mitigations**:
- Verify write permissions before attempting update
- Clear error message if access denied

### 3. Formatting Conflicts
**Risk**: Document may have custom styles that conflict with inserted content
**Mitigations**:
- Option to inherit document's default styles
- Option to apply explicit formatting from markdown

### 4. Large Content Issues
**Risk**: Very large markdown files could exceed API limits or timeout
**Mitigations**:
- Check content size before upload
- Batch requests appropriately
- Progress indicator for large uploads

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Parse tab ID from Google Doc URLs
- [ ] Write markdown content to specified tab
- [ ] Preserve markdown formatting (headers, bold, lists, links)
- [ ] Default to append mode with --replace option
- [ ] Confirmation prompt before modifying existing docs
- [ ] Clear error handling for permissions/access issues
- [ ] Tests with mocked API
close_reason: Implemented gdrive-write-tab command with full markdown-to-Docs-API conversion, safety features, and 17 new tests.

title: Implement markdown-to-Docs-API content converter
description:
Convert markdown content to Google Docs API batchUpdate requests.

## Markdown Elements to Support
- Headers (H1-H6) → Named styles (HEADING_1, etc.)
- Bold/Italic → UpdateTextStyleRequest
- Lists (bullet/numbered) → CreateParagraphBulletsRequest
- Links → UpdateTextStyleRequest with link field
- Code blocks → Monospace font style
- Paragraphs → Plain text with paragraph breaks

## Implementation
- Parse markdown using markdown-it-py AST
- Generate sequence of batchUpdate requests
- Handle proper indexing for text insertions

## Considerations
- Requests must be ordered correctly (insert text first, then apply styles)
- Index offsets change as text is inserted
- May need to batch requests to avoid API limits

title: Add write-to-tab CLI options and safety features
description:
Add CLI options for writing to existing document tabs.

## New CLI Options
- `--doc-url`: Google Doc URL (may include tab ID)
- `--doc-id`: Document ID (alternative to URL)
- `--tab-id`: Tab ID (optional, defaults to first tab)
- `--append`: Append to existing content (default)
- `--replace`: Clear tab before writing
- `--force`: Skip confirmation prompt

## Safety Features
1. Show existing tab content preview before write
2. Require confirmation unless --force
3. Display what will be written (truncated preview)
4. Warn if tab has existing content and --replace not specified

## Error Handling
- Document not found
- Tab not found
- No write permission
- Content too large

title: Investigate and implement writing markdown to Google Doc tabs
description:
Investigate whether it is possible to write to a new tab in an existing Google Document. If feasible, implement a feature that writes a markdown document to a new tab in a specified document, respecting styles and formatting.

## Research Findings

**Result: NOT FEASIBLE with current Google Docs API**

### What the API Supports
- Reading content from all tabs via `includeTabsContent=true`
- Writing/updating content in existing tabs via `tabId` parameter
- Accessing tab properties (ID, title, index, child tabs)

### What the API Does NOT Support
- Creating new tabs programmatically
- No `CreateTab`, `InsertTab`, or `AddTab` request types
- Apps Script also lacks tab creation methods
- Document creation ignores tabs parameter (GitHub issue #2559)

### Evidence
- Google Issue Tracker #375867285: Open feature request for tab creation
- No tab creation in batchUpdate request types list
- GitHub googleapis/google-api-python-client#2559 confirms limitation

## Alternative Approaches (for future consideration)
1. **Sections within a document**: Use headers/sections instead of tabs
2. **Separate documents**: Create new documents instead of tabs
3. **Monitor API updates**: Google may add this feature in the future

## Conclusion
Epic closed as not feasible. The Google Docs API does not currently support creating tabs programmatically. This is a known limitation with an open feature request at Google.

title: Research Google Docs API tab/section capabilities
description:
Research the Google Docs API to determine:
- Whether Google Docs supports 'tabs' or similar section concepts
- API methods for creating/managing tabs in documents
- Any limitations or restrictions on programmatic tab creation
- How content can be inserted into specific tabs

## Findings

### Google Docs Tabs Feature
Google Docs added tabs in October 2024, allowing users to create multiple tabs within a single document (similar to Google Sheets tabs).

### API Capabilities - What IS Supported
- **Reading tabs**: `documents.get()` with `includeTabsContent=true` returns all tabs
- **Writing to existing tabs**: `batchUpdate` requests can target specific tabs via `tabId` parameter
- **Tab properties**: Can read tab ID, title, index, and child tabs

### API Limitations - What is NOT Supported
**Creating new tabs programmatically is NOT possible.**

Evidence:
1. No `CreateTab` or `InsertTab` request type in batchUpdate API
2. Google Issue Tracker #375867285 confirms `addTab()` and `createTab()` methods do not exist
3. GitHub issue #2559 (Jan 2025) shows tabs parameter is ignored when creating documents
4. Apps Script DocumentApp also lacks tab creation methods

### Sources
- https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/how-tos/tabs
- https://issuetracker.google.com/issues/375867285
- https://github.com/googleapis/google-api-python-client/issues/2559

## Recommendation
**Feature is NOT feasible** with current Google Docs API. Alternative approaches:
1. Create separate documents instead of tabs
2. Use sections/headers within a single tab to organize content
3. Wait for Google to add tab creation to the API
